attribution.localizedCause: The previously attributed chronological 32-stream FMA-from-zero, post-dot prior-add, per-state BF16 materialization contract transfers exactly from ff1_19 to the prospectively frozen w_o_19 slice.

decision.rationale: Expand the exact treatment prospectively over all 1,024 w_o_19 output rows with byte-identical replay and a sign-negated control, compare all 1,048,576 words to the retained gradient, then use the sealed initial matrix and open upstream adjoint to validate the transpose residual.

hypothesis.rationale: The treatment had zero mismatches and zero maximum error. Prior-initialized and nonfused controls each missed 23 words, reverse state order missed 107,945, and sign negation missed all 131,072 words.

retiredDimensions: Treating prior-initialized FMA or nonfused multiply/add as equivalent w_o_19 accumulation
transferableLessons: The post-dot-add matrix-gradient contract is reusable across distinct layer-19 linear projections when operand order, state chronology, stream reduction, lane mapping, and BF16 materialization are preserved.
uncertainties: The result validates a 128-row gradient slice using a sealed source forward input; it does not yet prove all w_o_19 rows, an open pre-w_o forward path, the transpose residual, or compression value.

reasons: The revision-bound LibNC-free evaluator completed two byte-identical five-cell populations; the 131,072-word post-dot-add treatment matched the independently retained w_o_19 slice exactly; prior-initialized, nonfused, reverse-state, and sign-negated controls remained live; and dependency, source, memory, disk, and cleanup guards passed.
